ci-bot: CI alert: main pipeline red after merge — job smoke/gpu-shard-3 failed (OOM). Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/44/987 @Alice @Carla
Alice: ugh, main red after that merge. I can look in ~10m but def need a first responder.
Ben: I can grab logs now, pulling the failure trace.
Carla: quick skim: failing test looks like kvalloc_test::LargeBatchAllocator — OOM at alloc.cc:421. tagging eng-runtime.
Dan: I'm oncall for runtime, grabbing it now.
Alice: FYI my PR #5123 (prefetch tweak) merged ~3m before the failure, tagging here in case it's related.
Ben: can we rerun the job first? flakiness common on this job. /rerun main-smoke
ci-bot: Rerun queued. New run: https://ci.internal/runs/789 — status queued.
Dan: if rerun flaps I'll start a bisect. @Eve fyi for infra knobs.
Eve: noted — I can attach core dumps and bump runner mem if we need to reproduce.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: FAILED again, same shard. stderr snippet:
```
Allocation failed: tried 8.0GB > 7.5GB limit
Backtrace: alloc.cc:421 -> kvcache.cpp:78 -> test_runner.cc:210
```
Alice: ok bisect time. Dan, can you bisect commit range 10..HEAD? I suspect my prefetch but might be infra.
Dan: starting bisect now, will post which commit causes regression. Anyone with a repro, DM me.
Ben: fyi saw a similar blip yesterday on canary resolved after kernel bump — filing a follow-up if bisect points infra.
